pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit irregular polygonal geometries with softened edge gradients. Regions on the ventral neck and chest show larger spatial area compared to the smaller, more densely clustered polygons on the lateral flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored negative space forms a continuous topological network of intersecting pathways. Junction nodes consist of 3-way and 4-way intersections with relatively uniform pixel thickness throughout the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated 1D contour along the dorsal ridge of the neck, presenting as a dark fibrous silhouette against the background.
